config.cache: Cold means a fresh isolated Chromium context with no browser HTTP cache. Refresh and in-app navigation use their existing context; no warmup is counted as cold.
config.clock: Navigation uses the new document performance time origin (0). Actions start in a capture listener at the real trusted UI event, before application handlers.
config.endpoint: Expected page-memory facts and visible business result, current relevant control enabled, visible device images decoded, fonts loaded, and two stable requestAnimationFrame callbacks. The existing 450ms save cooldown is included.
config.boundary: Pure page-memory interaction sample; refresh resets all demonstrated business facts. No main-app IndexedDB save, persistence, physical factory work, scanner or printer execution is claimed.

warning: Run only after the coordinator releases the exclusive performance window. Calibration is a separate one-sample collector check and cannot pass formal acceptance.
